injuries.name: Mats Zuccarello
injuries.note: Zuccarello hasn't played since Oct. 24 due to the injury. He has an assist in six appearances in 2026-27. Zuccarello should serve in a top-six role once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Kevin Fiala
injuries.note: Fiala skated in a non-contact sweater during Thursday's morning skate, but Laviolette said later in the day that the 30-year-old still has several steps he needs to take before he's in consideration to return to game action. Fiala has been unavailable since the start of the regular season while continuing his recovery process from a lower leg fracture that required a pair of procedures.

injuries.name: Jan Jenik
injuries.note: Jenik had nine goals, 17 points and 29 PIM in 43 AHL regular-season outings between Belleville and Ontario in 2025-26. He will probably be sent to the minors once he's recovered from his injury.

injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: It was relayed Sept. 17 that Musty will be out long term due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on IR-NR doesn't come as a surprise. The 21-year-old had a relatively solid first full season with AHL San Jose in 2025-26, accounting for 21 goals, 45 points and a minus-14 rating over 61 regular-season games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.
